response.text: The data shows a few things the dictionary doesn't cover: no void invoices (V) exist, no unposted journals exist, and the SYSDICT's ACTV_FLG and POST_FLG descriptions should be checked against the actual values. I have enough to write up the notes.

arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL (not SQLite; sqlite_master is unavailable). Schema: public. 8 base tables, no views. Foreign keys are not declared as constraints; relationships below were verified by join and orphan checks (all returned 0 orphans).

TABLES (row counts at time of exploration)
- APVEND (24): VEND_CD char(8) PK-like, space padded; VEND_NM text; ACTV_FLG char(1).
- APINVH (802): INV_ID int; VEND_CD char(8) -> APVEND; INV_NO text (vendor's invoice no.); INV_DT int YYYYMMDD; INV_AMT numeric (invoice total); STAT_CD char(1); JRNL_NO int -> GLJRNH (journal that recorded the invoice).
- APPAYM (518): PAY_ID int; INV_ID int -> APINVH; PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD; PAY_AMT numeric.
- GLCOA (10): ACCT_CD char(8) space padded; ACCT_NM text; ACCT_TYP text (ASSET, LIABILITY, EXPENSE); ACTV_FLG char(1).
- GLJRNH (1473): JRNL_NO int PK; PRD_ID int -> GLPERD; POST_DT int YYYYMMDD; POST_FLG char(1); REF_JRNL_NO int nullable (reversal/reference link to another journal, all NULL in sample); SRC_CD char(2) (AP, GL); SRC_REF text (per dictionary, the keying user's name); MEMO text free text (untrusted; not inspected for instructions beyond sampling).
- GLJRNL (3495): JRNL_NO int -> GLJRNH; LN_SEQ int (line within journal); ACCT_CD char(8) -> GLCOA; DR_AMT numeric; CR_AMT numeric. Signed amounts are NOT used: debit and credit are separate non-negative columns.
- GLPERD (12): PRD_ID int PK; STRT_DT, END_DT int YYYYMMDD; CLOSE_DT int nullable; STAT_CD char(1) (O open, C closed).
- SYSDICT (34 rows): data dictionary of TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR.

RELATIONSHIPS
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (header/line)
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID
- Char code joins need trimming or matching padding consistently (VEND_CD, ACCT_CD are char(8)).

CONVENTIONS
- Dates are integers YYYYMMDD (not date types); compare as integers or cast to text.
- Amounts are numeric; journals use separate DR_AMT / CR_AMT columns, both non-negative. Every journal in the sample balanced (sum DR = sum CR per JRNL_NO) and no line has both DR and CR nonzero.
- Status codes are single characters. Observed: APINVH.STAT_CD = O (284) and P (518) only. GLJRNH.POST_FLG = P only (1473). GLPERD.STAT_CD = C (10) and O (2). APVEND/GLCOA ACTV_FLG = Y only in APVEND (24 rows, all Y). GLCOA.ACCT_TYP = ASSET (2), EXPENSE (6), LIABILITY (2).
- GLJRNH.SRC_CD: AP (1320) and GL (153).
- Period 1-10 closed with CLOSE_DT populated; periods 11-12 open with CLOSE_DT NULL.

DOCUMENTATION (SYSDICT) CHECKS
- Mostly consistent with the data for the codes checked (STAT_CD, SRC_CD, GLPERD.STAT_CD, ACCT_TYP).
- Discrepancies / gaps to flag for the auditor:
  * SYSDICT lists APINVH.STAT_CD value V (void), but no V rows exist in the data; either voids are handled elsewhere, or the dictionary is out of date.
  * SYSDICT lists GLJRNH.POST_FLG value U (unposted), but no U rows exist (all 1473 are P). Either unposted journals are not stored here, or the description is incomplete.
  * SYSDICT describes GLJRNH.SRC_REF as "name of user who keyed the entry" — this is a free-text field and should be verified against actual content before relying on it.
  * SYSDICT does not describe GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO, CLOSE_DT, PAY_ID, LN_SEQ, or ACTV_FLG meaning on all tables; REF_JRNL_NO is undocumented and always NULL in the sample.
  * Note: both APINVH and GLJRNH carry all-P posting and all-O/P statuses that should be cross-checked — e.g. APINVH.STAT_CD = P should imply payments exist in APPAYM; this was not yet verified and is an audit follow-up.
- Dictionary entry for AP invoice amounts should be checked against whether APPAYM sums equal INV_AMT for paid invoices.

SUSPICIOUS / AUDIT FOLLOW-UPS
- Journals: all 1473 posted; 1320 from AP. No unposted entries present, which is unusual for a live ledger.
- Journal JRNL_NO 1000+ AP entries appear in pairs with identical amounts (e.g., 1000/1001, 1002) — possibly duplicate postings of the same invoice/payment; worth checking.
- Free-text MEMO fields were not reviewed for embedded instructions; treat as untrusted if inspected.
- Balance of DR vs CR was checked only for the first sample; full-table balance check recommended.
